summary:
Scope: source contract for M0 of the native-chain re-host (plan .github docs/coordination/2026-10-30-native-chain-rehost-fdev.md; Delivery FS.GG.Coordination#1101 under .github#4650), merged in Coordination#1087 as 21170a25. It starts no window or guest and grants no operation, clock, claim or credential; M1 (#1102) is a separate Root selection.

Where: deployment/qualification-runner/fdev/fdev_native.py, provider fdev-kvm-qualification-v1. Subcommands: preflight (read-only, every precondition Supported/Unsupported/Unknown; Unknown is never success), launch --dry-run (PlanOnly executor: prints the exact effect plan, writes nothing), launch, window-exit, attach-home-io, validate-evidence, census (read-only, under sudo -n), qmp-powerdown (guest ExecStop) and collect.

Window rules (Root rulings on .github#4778: 6522829725, 6526677331, 6527516917, 6530390005): lanes of developer, fsgg-store-dev and fsgg-learn-qual must hold only idle shells; exempt sessions (Root, readback, the launcher itself) may not run build servers; no other fsgg-native-* unit and no v3-storage@*; MemAvailable >= 26 GiB; pool space plus 64 GiB; Home df and an optional Home host-memory input with a Root floor (absent is Unknown). Capacity and exclusivity are re-read after the claim. io.max caps go through systemctl set-property --runtime on the drained lane units and the store, LEARN and discovered SC2 service units, for the HDD-backed mounts resolved to whole-disk major:minor; never user-1000.slice, an exempt session or the launcher; kernel readback at entry and exit. The claim is O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and refuses forever; retired 83a08/69db/2ae4/d2f2 refuse including by prefix. The Root selection comment must carry <!-- fsgg:fdev-native-selection/v1 operation=<op> step=<step> -->.

Exit contract: after the claim every path (refusal, error, signal) stops any guest or collector whose start was attempted but whose terminal state was not observed (bounded by retire + 30 s) before removing caps, attempts every cap removal (an absent unit is already gone), reverts fsgg-native.slice and fsgg-native-collect.slice, and writes a durable record to /srv/v3-pool/native/claims/<op>.window.json. Pending rule shared by launch and window-exit: a cap still read back, or a removal error on a target whose cgroup is absent (its runtime drop-in may remain); launch then exits non-zero with a window-exit directive. SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP raise Interrupted once per arming (the handler disarms before raising; disarmed during the claim and window exit). Every systemd effect is bounded at 30 s; the launcher scope RuntimeMaxSec must be >= scope_runtime_seconds, which strictly exceeds the abnormal-path internal bound, and TimeoutStopSec covers window exit.

Evidence fsgg.fdev-native-window-evidence/1 is cooperative and never independent of fdev or Home (constant independence false, tamperProof false, hostKind fdev-agent-vm-drained-window, ioSharedWithHostCoTenants true). sharedCodexHost is false only when exclusivity passes at entry and exit and no new lane unit appeared; validate_evidence recomputes it. I/O correspondence is not-established unless Home-observed iostat evidence covering the whole window is supplied, and then only window-evidence-captured-awaiting-root with acceptedByRoot false. validate_target_data accepts hostKind and ioSharedWithHostCoTenants only for provider fdev-kvm-qualification-v1; sharedCodexHost must still be false.

Verification at merge: 74 fdev controls and a 69-mutant set (the independent reviewers 25 adapted plus repair reverts), three independent review rounds ending APPROVED at 5453da4d. Not established: any real window, io.max effect, nested boot (vvfat seed and -mem-prealloc are golden-file only), or I/O correspondence. Deferred plan-M0 items (early Native.Qualification preflight, seed/control images, export and #4820 Commit, retirement helper, observe-only resume) are tracked under .github#4650. Lesson: the first two review rounds each found an exit path that left effects behind (crash recovery stopping at the first error; a guest left running under an exception), so exit paths need causal tests per exception site, not only per refusal.
title: fdev native-window launcher: drained exclusive window, fail-closed checks, cooperative evidence (M0)
